items.headline: SK Group's data-center arm in talks to fund $350B AI infrastructure buildout
items.why: One of the largest AI capex financing plans reported this year; signals compute buildout scale continuing to accelerate

items.headline: OpenAI nears $30B funding round at $1.25T valuation, led by UAE investors and Coatue
items.why: Bridge-to-IPO financing resets the benchmark valuation for private AI labs and tests investor appetite at scale

items.headline: Nvidia and supply-chain partners announce capacity expansion to accelerate AI infrastructure buildout
items.why: Signals Nvidia moving to ease the capacity bottlenecks constraining AI chip and server supply

items.headline: Nvidia's guarantees and commitments backing new AI data centers reach up to $164.5B, report says
items.why: Shows scale of Nvidia's off-balance-sheet exposure to the AI buildout, a key solvency/circularity risk

items.headline: Anthropic reportedly eyeing IPO as early as mid-November at ~$2T valuation, up from $965B private mark
items.why: Would be the largest AI IPO yet and a key read on public-market appetite for AI-lab valuations

items.headline: PBOC signals multi-month shift to overnight rate as its main policy lever
items.why: Changes China's rate-setting framework, relevant to easing path, yuan and liquidity conditions investors price into China/AI-adjacent equities

items.headline: Alibaba, ByteDance and Tencent order hundreds of thousands of Huawei Ascend 950 chips as DeepSeek V4 is adapted to Ascend
items.why: Shows Chinese hyperscalers shifting AI training/inference workloads to domestic silicon, shrinking Nvidia's addressable China market

items.headline: China Q3 GDP grows 4.5% y/y, beating estimates and accelerating from Q2's 4.3%
items.why: Stronger China growth supports domestic AI capex (Alibaba, Tencent, Huawei) and eases hard-landing tail risk for global markets.

items.headline: Anthropic in talks for $45B, six-year AI compute deal with cloud provider Nscale
items.why: Major AI lab locking in large external compute supply underscores continued capex arms race among frontier labs

items.headline: Anthropic framed as the AI sector's last major 2026 IPO hope, seeking up to $2T valuation vs. investor pushback toward $1.5T
items.why: Would be the first major AI-lab public listing, resetting public-market comps for AI valuations

items.headline: China proposes export controls on 40 technologies including AI and chips, an apparent response to US curbs
items.why: Escalates US-China tech trade risk and threatens Chinese AI supply-chain inputs just as US policy on chip exports loosens

items.headline: Nvidia's China data-center chip market share fell to 34% in H1 2026, shipments down 44% y/y
items.why: Quantifies how far export controls have cut Nvidia's China AI accelerator business, a read on lost TAM

items.headline: PBOC runs 700B yuan reverse repo, October net liquidity injection ~400B yuan, signaling shift to policy easing
items.why: Easing bias affects China growth/liquidity backdrop relevant to China AI and chip names

items.headline: US September CPI rose 3.7% y/y (vs. 3.6% est.) and core CPI 2.6%, a hotter-than-expected print
items.why: Puts the Fed's Oct 28 rate decision and the cutting path in doubt, pressuring risk assets including AI-linked equities
